forbidden.message: ORM / query builder import: the standard uses hand-written SQL with psycopg 3
psycopg2 import: use psycopg 3 (async) with psycopg_pool
SQL built with %, + or .format(): pass parameters as %(name)s placeholders in a dict
HTTPException in a router/service/core: raise a DomainError subclass with its status_code (api/errors.py translates it)
try/except in a router: routers stay thin; exceptions are translated only in api/errors.py
JSONResponse in a router: return ApiResponse[...] (annotated return type)
sync def in a router: endpoints are async def (all I/O is async)
os.getenv / os.environ outside core/settings.py: read configuration through Settings (pydantic-settings)
Token read outside api/security.py: use the get_current_user dependency (CurrentUserDep)
CORS allow_origins=["*"]: list explicit origins from Settings
JWT verification disabled: always verify signature and expiry

recommendedSkills.why: Official FastAPI skill: current idioms for dependencies (Annotated[..., Depends(...)] aliases), lifespan, routers and testing.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Ignore SQLModel/SQLAlchemy (no ORM: hand-written SQL with psycopg 3), sync def by default (all I/O is async here), returning the model directly (always ApiResponse[...]) and ty (mypy --strict here).

recommendedSkills.why: asyncio patterns: gather/TaskGroup, timeouts, cancellation, avoiding blocking calls in async code.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Background work goes through the BackgroundTaskQueue started in the lifespan, not ad-hoc create_task calls in request handlers.

recommendedSkills.why: pytest fixtures, parametrization and async tests.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Ignore SQLAlchemy-based examples: services and validators are tested with fake repositories that implement the core Protocol (or AsyncMock); never against a shared database.

recommendedSkills.why: PostgreSQL indexing, query plans, locking and schema design guidance.
recommendedSkills.conflicts: Ignore Supabase-specific parts (RLS policies, auth.uid(), Supabase client) unless the project profile declares Supabase.
